# The Concept of God after Auschwitz

*[Hans Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) · 1987 · *Der Gottesbegriff nach Auschwitz**

A lecture given in 1984 and published as a book in 1987. Through a "myth" he presents as a hypothesis, [Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) gives up divine omnipotence to save God's goodness and intelligibility: a God who divested himself of power in creating the world, and whom human beings can help.
